words.enDefinition: The part of a seller's website that shoppers see and buy from.

examples.en: My roommate found the storage boxes through the brand's online storefront during our move.
examples.zh: 我们搬家时，室友在该品牌的「线上店面」找到了那些收纳盒。

examples.en: The campus shop's online storefront showed more notebook designs than the display near the register.
examples.zh: 校园商店的「线上店面」展示的笔记本款式比收银台附近陈列的更多。

words.enDefinition: A website where multiple sellers offer goods to shoppers.

examples.en: An online marketplace showed the same lamp offered by three sellers on one page.
examples.zh: 一家「电商交易平台」在同一页面列出了三个卖家出售的同款台灯。

examples.en: I found replacement inserts for my planner on an online marketplace for stationery enthusiasts.
examples.zh: 我在面向文具爱好者的「电商交易平台」找到了能替换到手账里的内页。

words.enDefinition: An independent merchant selling through an online retailer's platform.

examples.en: The backpack was listed by a third-party seller on the site my roommate usually uses.
examples.zh: 那款背包是由「第三方卖家」发布在室友常用的网站上的。

examples.en: We checked which third-party seller offered the case in the color we wanted for class.
examples.zh: 我们查看了哪家「第三方卖家」有上课时想用的那个颜色的保护套。

collocations: a third-party seller on the site

words.enDefinition: A shop operated by a brand or someone it has authorized to represent it.

examples.en: I opened the official store to see which refills would fit my favorite pen.
examples.zh: 我打开「官方店铺」，想看看哪些替芯适合我最喜欢的那支笔。

examples.en: The official store listed the replacement pieces individually, which was helpful for our dorm room.
examples.zh: 「官方店铺」单独出售每个配件，这对我们宿舍来说很方便。

words.enDefinition: An item available for purchase only through an online shop.

examples.en: The gray desk mat was labeled an online exclusive beside the other colors on the site.
examples.zh: 网站上，灰色桌垫在其他颜色旁标为「线上专供款」。

examples.en: I saved the online exclusive because I could not find the design at the campus shop.
examples.zh: 我在校园商店找不到那个款式，就把这个「线上专供款」收藏了。

words.enDefinition: An entry showing an item offered for sale online.

examples.en: The product listing showed a close-up of the clip on the reading light near the bottom.
examples.zh: 「商品刊登信息」下方有阅读灯夹子的特写照片。

examples.en: I shared the product listing with my roommate so she could check the organizer’s dimensions.
examples.zh: 我把「商品刊登信息」发给了室友，让她看看收纳架的尺寸。

words.enDefinition: The web page containing details and buying options for a particular product.

examples.en: The product page showed which colors were available for the larger pencil case.
examples.zh: 「商品详情页」显示了大号笔袋有哪些颜色可以买。

examples.en: I left the product page open while I measured the shelf in my room again.
examples.zh: 我再次测量房间里的架子时，让「商品详情页」保持打开。

words.enDefinition: A web page grouping products of a particular type.

examples.en: The category page put desk lamps and clip lights under the same heading for students.
examples.zh: 「商品分类页」把台灯和夹式灯放在了同一个面向学生的栏目下。

examples.en: I returned to the category page after deciding I wanted a larger storage box.
examples.zh: 决定买大一点的收纳盒后，我回到了「商品分类页」。

words.enDefinition: To browse a store by groups such as stationery, lighting, or storage.

examples.en: I chose “Shop by category” to find storage supplies without searching for a specific item.
examples.zh: 我选了「按商品分类选购」，不用搜索某件具体商品就找到了收纳用品。

examples.en: The page offered a shop by category menu with a separate section for stationery.
examples.zh: 页面提供了「按商品分类选购」菜单，其中有单独的文具分类。

collocations: a link marked shop by category

words.enDefinition: The items or pages shown after a user searches for something.

examples.en: The search results included both the lamp itself and spare bulbs for the same model.
examples.zh: 「搜索结果」既包括整盏灯，也包括同款灯的备用灯泡。

examples.en: I scrolled through the search results and noticed several cases for the previous tablet model.
examples.zh: 我浏览了「搜索结果」，发现有好几款上一代平板的保护套。

words.enDefinition: A result that matches the words or identifier entered in a search.

examples.en: I entered the model number but did not find an exact match in the results.
examples.zh: 我输入了型号，却没有在结果里找到「完全匹配项」。

examples.en: The site showed an exact match for the refill named on my empty pen packet.
examples.zh: 网站显示了一款与我用完的笔的包装上注明的替芯「完全匹配」的商品。

collocations: an exact match for the model

words.enDefinition: To look for an item online by typing its model identifier.

examples.en: I chose to search by model number because the store had several nearly identical chargers.
examples.zh: 这家店有好几款几乎一模一样的充电器，所以我选择「按型号搜索」。

examples.en: The site lets you search by model number when looking for a matching tablet cover.
examples.zh: 在该网站查找配套的平板保护套时，可以「按型号搜索」。

collocations: an option to search by model number
search by model number on the site

words.enDefinition: To show only products made by selected brands.

examples.en: I used the menu to filter by brand because I only wanted original replacement tips.
examples.zh: 我只想买原厂替换笔尖，就用了菜单里的「按品牌筛选」。

examples.en: The shop lets visitors filter by brand without losing the type of bag they selected.
examples.zh: 顾客在这家店「按品牌筛选」时，可以保留已选的包袋类别。

collocations: filter by brand on the results page
an option to filter by brand

words.enDefinition: To show products based on whether they are currently available to buy.

examples.en: My roommate used a checkbox to filter by availability before choosing a desk chair online.
examples.zh: 室友在网上选书桌椅前，用复选框「按库存状态筛选」。

examples.en: The page lets shoppers filter by availability, which helped when I needed a notebook soon.
examples.zh: 页面允许顾客「按库存状态筛选」，在我急需一本笔记本时很方便。

collocations: an option to filter by availability

words.enDefinition: To remove selected search filters and show the broader results again.

examples.en: I clicked “Clear filters” when none of the storage boxes matched my original choices.
examples.zh: 当没有收纳盒符合先前的选项时，我点了「清除筛选条件」。

examples.en: The clear filters button brought back the items I had accidentally hidden from the results.
examples.zh: 「清除筛选条件」按钮把我不小心从结果里隐藏的商品重新显示出来。

collocations: clear filters on a results page

words.enDefinition: To order results by how closely they match a search.

examples.en: I chose to sort by relevance after searching for a binder that fits narrow shelves.
examples.zh: 搜索适合窄层架的活页夹后，我选择了「按相关性排序」。

examples.en: The site will sort by relevance unless another order is selected from the menu.
examples.zh: 除非在菜单里另选一种顺序，网站会「按相关性排序」。

collocations: set results to sort by relevance

words.enDefinition: To place recently added products at the beginning of a list.

examples.en: I used the option to sort by newest when browsing designs for this semester's planner.
examples.zh: 浏览本学期手账的款式时，我用了「按上新时间排序」选项。

examples.en: The menu let me sort by newest, so the latest lamp designs appeared first.
examples.zh: 我可以通过菜单「按上新时间排序」，这样最新款的台灯就会显示在最前面。

collocations: set results to sort by newest

words.enDefinition: A message stating that the search produced no matching items.

examples.en: The site displayed “No results found” until I removed a space from the model number.
examples.zh: 我去掉型号中的一个空格之前，网站一直显示「未找到结果」。

examples.en: I saw “No results found” after filtering the selection down to a single color.
examples.zh: 把选项筛到只剩一种颜色后，我看到了「未找到结果」。

collocations: a page saying no results found

words.enDefinition: Items shown because they are similar to or connected with the one being viewed.

examples.en: I found the correct notebook refills in the related products section below the main photo.
examples.zh: 我在主图下方的「相关商品」栏里找到了合适的笔记本内页。

examples.en: The related products included several mounts designed for the same type of reading lamp.
examples.zh: 「相关商品」中有几种为同类阅读灯设计的底座。

words.enDefinition: A website label for items the shopper has looked at lately.

examples.en: The recently viewed section showed the two laptop stands I had considered the night before.
examples.zh: 「最近浏览」栏显示了我前一晚考虑过的两款电脑支架。

examples.en: I found the blue pencil case again through the recently viewed list on the homepage.
examples.zh: 我在首页的「最近浏览」列表里重新找到了蓝色笔袋。

words.enDefinition: A saved list of products a shopper might want later.

examples.en: My roommate put the lamp on her wish list while she measured the space beside her bed.
examples.zh: 室友把灯加到了「心愿单」，留着先量一下床边还有多少空间。

examples.en: I shared my wish list with my sister so she could see my favorite notebook designs.
examples.zh: 我把「心愿单」分享给了姐姐，让她看看我最喜欢的笔记本款式。

collocations: add something to a wish list

words.enDefinition: Available to buy again after previously selling out.

examples.en: The small white desk organizer came back in stock a few days before term started.
examples.zh: 开学前几天，小号白色桌面收纳架「已补货」。

examples.en: The page said the refill was back in stock, so I could finally order it.
examples.zh: 页面显示替芯「已补货」，我终于可以买了。

collocations: get a back in stock email

words.enDefinition: Already prepared and available to be sent out to the buyer.

examples.en: The listing marked the blue notebook as ready to ship, unlike the personalized version.
examples.zh: 商品页把蓝色笔记本标为「可立即发货」，个性化款则不同。

examples.en: I chose the lamp that was ready to ship because the other one was still being made.
examples.zh: 我选了「可立即发货」的那款台灯，因为另一款还在制作。

collocations: be ready to ship by Monday

words.enDefinition: An interface option to request a message when an item becomes available.

examples.en: I selected “Notify me when available” for the blue folder rather than choosing another color.
examples.zh: 我给蓝色文件夹选了「到货时通知我」，没有换其他颜色。

examples.en: The page displayed “Notify me when available” next to the campus planner I had chosen.
examples.zh: 页面在我选好的校园手账旁显示「到货时通知我」。

collocations: a notify me when available button
a link marked notify me when available

words.enDefinition: A small quantity remaining available to order.

examples.en: A limited stock notice appeared beside the gray chair after I selected the seat color.
examples.zh: 我选好座椅颜色后，灰色椅子旁出现了「库存有限」的提示。

examples.en: The store had limited stock of the narrower lamp, which fit my side table.
examples.zh: 能放在我边桌上的窄款台灯，店里「库存有限」。

words.enDefinition: No longer made or offered as part of the seller's current range.

examples.en: The smaller clock was discontinued, but the site still displayed its photo for reference.
examples.zh: 小号时钟「已停产」，但网站仍展示它的照片供参考。

examples.en: I found out my favorite pencil case was discontinued when the page showed its replacement.
examples.zh: 看到页面推荐它的替代款，我才发现最喜欢的笔袋「已停产」。

words.enDefinition: A product recently added to a store's selection.

examples.en: The pen set was a new arrival, so the site displayed it near the top.
examples.zh: 那套笔是「新上架商品」，所以网站把它放在了靠上的位置。

examples.en: I browsed the new arrivals to find a notebook with paper thick enough for markers.
examples.zh: 我浏览了「新上架商品」，想找一本纸张够厚、适合用马克笔的笔记本。

words.enDefinition: A code that identifies one design or version of a product.

examples.en: I copied the model number from the bottom of my keyboard before shopping for parts.
examples.zh: 我在买配件前抄下了键盘底部的「型号」。

examples.en: The product page listed the model number beside the photo of the charger I needed.
examples.zh: 商品页在我需要的充电器照片旁列出了「型号」。

words.enDefinition: The name displayed at the top of an online product listing.

examples.en: The product title mentioned a set, but the description explained exactly how many pieces were included.
examples.zh: 「商品标题」写的是套装，而详情说明了具体包含几件。

examples.en: I searched for the exact product title after my classmate sent me a screenshot.
examples.zh: 同学发来截图后，我搜索了完整的「商品标题」。

collocations: include details in the product title
a product title on the results page

words.enDefinition: Written information about an item's features, materials, or intended use.

examples.en: The product description said the notebook was refillable, which mattered more to me than the color.
examples.zh: 「商品详情说明」写着笔记本可以更换内页，这对我来说比颜色更重要。

examples.en: I checked the product description to see whether the desk lamp could tilt forward.
examples.zh: 我查看了「商品详情说明」，想知道台灯能不能向前倾斜。

words.enDefinition: A visual showing an item on a product page or listing.

examples.en: The first product image showed the entire bag, and the next showed the inside pockets.
examples.zh: 第一张「商品图片」展示整个包，下一张展示内袋。

examples.en: I enlarged the product image so my roommate could see where the cable came out.
examples.zh: 我放大了「商品图片」，让室友能看见线缆从哪里伸出来。

words.enDefinition: A small image representing a product in a list or gallery.

examples.en: I clicked the product thumbnail to see a bigger picture of the backpack's front pocket.
examples.zh: 我点了「商品缩略图」，想看背包前袋的放大图。

examples.en: The product thumbnail showed the organizer closed, so I opened the listing for more pictures.
examples.zh: 「商品缩略图」里收纳架是合上的，于是我打开商品页查看更多图片。

words.enDefinition: The group of images or videos that show a product from different views.

examples.en: The product gallery included a short video showing the desk stand from several angles.
examples.zh: 「商品图库」里有一段从不同角度展示桌面支架的短视频。

examples.en: I opened the product gallery to see the stitching on the inside of the bag.
examples.zh: 我打开「商品图库」，想看包内侧的针脚。

collocations: a video in the product gallery

words.enDefinition: A close photograph of a small feature or part of an item.

examples.en: A detail shot showed the stitching on the handle where the bag usually wears out.
examples.zh: 一张「细节特写」展示了提手易磨损部位的针脚。

examples.en: I liked the zipper better after seeing it clearly in the final detail shot.
examples.zh: 在最后一张「细节特写」里看清拉链后，我更喜欢它了。

collocations: a detail shot of the stitching

words.enDefinition: Shown alongside something familiar so viewers can judge the item's size.

examples.en: There was a pencil shown for scale beside the organizer in the second picture.
examples.zh: 第二张图片里，收纳架旁有一支铅笔「用于展示大小比例」。

examples.en: A hand was shown for scale, and I could tell the lamp base was tiny.
examples.zh: 图里有一只手「用于展示大小比例」，我看得出台灯底座非常小。

words.enDefinition: A note saying that an image is an example and may differ from what is supplied.

examples.en: The caption said “Image for illustration only” beneath the photo of the desk organizer.
examples.zh: 收纳架照片下方的文字写着「图片仅供参考」。

examples.en: I noticed “Image for illustration only” after checking whether the pictured accessories were included.
examples.zh: 我核对图片里的配件是否随附后，留意到了「图片仅供参考」。

collocations: a note reading image for illustration only
mark a picture image for illustration only
a caption saying image for illustration only

words.enDefinition: A small sample showing the color available for an item.

examples.en: I clicked the green color swatch and the photo switched to the matching folder.
examples.zh: 我点了绿色的「色样」，图片就切换成对应的文件夹。

examples.en: One color swatch looked almost white, but the label below it said pale blue.
examples.zh: 一个「色样」看上去几乎是白色的，下面却标的是浅蓝色。

words.enDefinition: A particular combination of colors used for one version of a product.

examples.en: The colorway I liked had a green body with small yellow details along the edges.
examples.zh: 我喜欢的「配色款」以绿色为主，边缘带有黄色小细节。

examples.en: My friend chose a different colorway of the same backpack so we could tell them apart.
examples.zh: 朋友选了同款背包的另一个「配色款」，这样我们就能分清谁的是谁的。

words.enDefinition: To pick the shade or color option wanted for an item.

examples.en: I had to select a color before the site showed which sizes were available.
examples.zh: 我得先「选择颜色」，网站才会显示有哪些尺寸可以买。

examples.en: The listing asked me to select a color even though the main photo showed only black.
examples.zh: 虽然主图只展示黑色，商品页还是让我「选择颜色」。

collocations: select a color before adding an item
select a color from the menu

words.enDefinition: A label indicating that an item is offered in just one standard size.

examples.en: The rain cover came in one size, and the page listed its exact measurements below.
examples.zh: 那款防雨罩只有「均码」，页面在下方列出了具体尺寸。

examples.en: The pouch was marked one size instead of offering separate small and large versions online.
examples.zh: 那款小包网上标的是「均码」，没有单独的小号和大号可选。

words.enDefinition: The measurements of the item itself, such as its width, height, or depth.

examples.en: I checked the item dimensions to see if the organizer would fit on my shelf.
examples.zh: 我查看了「商品尺寸」，想知道收纳架能不能放在我的层架上。

examples.en: The item dimensions were listed below the photos on the page for the pen tray.
examples.zh: 笔盘页面的照片下方列出了「商品尺寸」。

words.enDefinition: The measurements of the usable space inside an item.

examples.en: I checked the interior dimensions before choosing a box for my camera and charger.
examples.zh: 为相机和充电器挑盒子之前，我查看了「内部尺寸」。

examples.en: The interior dimensions mattered more than the outside width because the folders had rigid covers.
examples.zh: 文件夹的封面是硬的，所以「内部尺寸」比外部宽度更重要。

words.enDefinition: The real size of an item without any enlargement or reduction.

examples.en: A note explained that the preview showed the sticker at actual size when printed.
examples.zh: 一条说明写着，预览图打印后按贴纸的「实际大小」呈现。

examples.en: I wanted to see the actual size of the label before ordering a whole sheet.
examples.zh: 订购一整张标签前，我想看看单个标签的「实际大小」。

words.enDefinition: The external measurements of a package or box rather than the item inside.

examples.en: The package dimensions were much larger than the dimensions of the lamp shown in the listing.
examples.zh: 「包装尺寸」比商品页上那盏台灯本身的尺寸大得多。

examples.en: I checked the package dimensions to see whether the box might fit in my locker.
examples.zh: 我查看了「包装尺寸」，想知道箱子能不能放进储物柜。

words.enDefinition: A way of listing width first and height second in measurements.

examples.en: The frame measurements were listed as width by height in the sheet beneath the pictures.
examples.zh: 相框的尺寸在照片下方的表格中按「宽乘高」列出。

examples.en: I checked whether the figures were given as width by height before ordering the board.
examples.zh: 订购那块板之前，我核对了尺寸是不是按「宽乘高」写的。

collocations: measurements given as width by height

words.enDefinition: Measurements of an item when it has been folded down.

examples.en: The folded dimensions mattered because I wanted to keep the laptop stand in my drawer.
examples.zh: 「折叠后尺寸」很重要，因为我想把电脑支架放进抽屉。

examples.en: One student mentioned the folded dimensions when recommending the drying rack for small dorm rooms.
examples.zh: 一名同学推荐这个适合小宿舍的晾衣架时，提到了「折叠后尺寸」。

words.enDefinition: The distance from one end of a power or connecting cord to the other.

examples.en: The cord length was listed below the photo of the lamp beside the specifications.
examples.zh: 「线缆长度」列在台灯照片下方的规格表旁。

examples.en: I checked the cord length because the socket in my room is behind the desk.
examples.zh: 我查看了「线缆长度」，因为房间里的插座在书桌后面。

collocations: an item with an adjustable cord length

words.enDefinition: The maximum weight an item is designed to hold.

examples.en: I compared the shelf's weight capacity with the weight of the books I keep beside my bed.
examples.zh: 我把架子的「承重上限」和床边那些书的重量作了比较。

examples.en: The listing stated a separate weight capacity for each of the two wall hooks.
examples.zh: 商品页分别注明了两个墙钩各自的「承重上限」。

words.enDefinition: Information naming the materials an item is made from, often with percentages.

examples.en: The material composition showed that the pencil pouch was made mostly from recycled fabric.
examples.zh: 「材料成分」说明这个笔袋主要由再生面料制成。

examples.en: I checked the material composition because I wanted a notebook cover I could wipe clean.
examples.zh: 我想买一款能擦干净的笔记本封套，所以查看了「材料成分」。

words.enDefinition: A measure of how heavy a type of paper is, often given in grams per square metre.

examples.en: I looked at the paper weight before buying sketch paper for our afternoon art workshop.
examples.zh: 为下午的美术研讨活动买素描纸前，我查看了「纸张克重」。

examples.en: The product page showed the paper weight just below a close-up of the notebook pages.
examples.zh: 商品页在笔记本内页的特写正下方注明了「纸张克重」。

collocations: paper weight in grams per square metre

words.enDefinition: A surface treatment that gives an item little or no shine.

examples.en: I chose the notebook with a matte finish because I preferred how it looked.
examples.zh: 我选了「哑光表面」的笔记本，因为我更喜欢它的外观。

examples.en: The photo of the desk tray showed its matte finish clearly in the sunlight.
examples.zh: 桌面托盘的照片在太阳光下清楚地展示了它的「哑光表面」。

collocations: a cover with a matte finish

words.enDefinition: A surface treatment that makes an item look shiny.

examples.en: The glossy finish on the tablet cover reflected the window in one review photo.
examples.zh: 一张评价照片里，平板保护套的「亮光表面」映出了窗户。

examples.en: The site showed a close-up of the glossy finish on the pale blue desk tray.
examples.zh: 网站用一张特写展示了浅蓝色桌面托盘的「亮光表面」。

collocations: a cover with a glossy finish

words.enDefinition: A fit intended to work with many common models rather than one specific model.

examples.en: The page advertised a universal fit for the mount but still listed the supported sizes.
examples.zh: 页面把底座标为「通用适配」，但仍列出了支持的尺寸。

examples.en: A diagram explained the range of devices covered by the mount's universal fit in the listing.
examples.zh: 商品页的示意图说明了底座「通用适配」所涵盖的设备范围。

collocations: a mount with a universal fit

words.enDefinition: Able to work together with a stated device, part, or product.

examples.en: The new pen tip was compatible with my tablet according to the listing details.
examples.zh: 商品详情注明，新笔尖「与我的平板兼容」。

examples.en: I asked whether the spare cable was compatible with the charger in my room.
examples.zh: 我问了一下备用线缆「是否与我房间里的充电器兼容」。

collocations: check what it is compatible with

words.enDefinition: The equipment models an item is made to work with.

examples.en: My tablet was near the bottom of the list of supported models for the cover.
examples.zh: 我的平板在这个保护套的「支持型号」列表靠下的位置。

examples.en: The adapter came with a link to a complete list of supported models online.
examples.zh: 那个适配器附有一个链接，可以在网上查看完整的「支持的型号」列表。

collocations: show supported models on the page

words.enDefinition: A new tip designed to replace a worn or damaged one on a pen or stylus.

examples.en: I looked for a replacement tip for the stylus I use to annotate lecture slides.
examples.zh: 我想给用来批注课件的触控笔买一个「替换笔尖」。

examples.en: The product gallery showed the replacement tip alongside the stylus it was made for.
examples.zh: 商品图片库把「替换笔尖」和它适配的触控笔放在一起展示。

collocations: a replacement tip for a stylus

words.enDefinition: A package of supplies designed to replenish an existing item or container.

examples.en: I ordered a refill pack of notebook pages after filling the ones from orientation week.
examples.zh: 我写满了迎新周领到的笔记本内页后，订了一份内页「补充装」。

examples.en: The refill pack used the same size of insert as the planner on my desk.
examples.zh: 这份「补充装」的内页尺寸和我桌上的手账相同。

words.enDefinition: Available as a separate purchase and excluded from the item being viewed.

examples.en: The picture showed a cable, but the description said it was sold separately online.
examples.zh: 图片里有一根线，但说明写着它在网上「另售」。

examples.en: I noticed the handle was sold separately after reading the notes below the main photo.
examples.zh: 我读了主图下的说明，才注意到提手是「另售」的。

words.enDefinition: Extra items that come with the product as part of the purchase.

examples.en: The included accessories were shown in a separate photograph beside the image of the lamp.
examples.zh: 「随附配件」单独拍了一张照片，放在台灯图片旁边。

examples.en: The description listed the included accessories, so I knew the cable came with the lamp.
examples.zh: 说明列出了「随附配件」，我因此知道台灯自带线缆。

collocations: a photo of the included accessories

words.enDefinition: A heading introducing the items included in a product's package.

examples.en: The “What's in the box” section listed a stand, a cable, and a printed leaflet.
examples.zh: 「包装内含物」一栏列了一个支架、一根线和一份印刷说明单。

examples.en: I checked “What's in the box” before deciding whether to add a cable to the order.
examples.zh: 我先看了「包装内含物」，再决定订单里要不要加一根线。

collocations: a section titled what's in the box
a what's in the box list

words.enDefinition: A package containing several different versions of a similar item.

examples.en: The variety pack contained four different pen colors that I could use for lecture notes.
examples.zh: 那份「混合组合装」有四种颜色的笔，我上课记笔记时可以用。

examples.en: I bought a variety pack of binder clips to try the different sizes before term.
examples.zh: 开学前我买了一份长尾夹「混合组合装」，想试试不同的尺寸。

words.enDefinition: Available only as a group of items that are sold together.

examples.en: The two drawers were sold as a set even though I needed only the shorter one.
examples.zh: 那两个抽屉是「成套出售」的，虽然我只需要较矮的那个。

examples.en: The listing said the matching folders were sold as a set of six in total.
examples.zh: 商品页注明，这些配套的文件夹每六个一组「成套出售」。

collocations: listed as sold as a set
marked sold as a set online

words.enDefinition: Prepared so it can be used without assembly or other setup.

examples.en: The desk organizer came ready to use, with no pieces for me to put together.
examples.zh: 这个桌面收纳架到手「可直接使用」，我不需要组装任何部件。

examples.en: The listing said the pen was ready to use and showed the refill already inside.
examples.zh: 商品页显示替芯已装在笔里，注明这支笔「可直接使用」。

words.enDefinition: A notice saying the batteries needed by a product are not supplied.

examples.en: The listing said “Batteries not included” just below the photograph of the small alarm clock.
examples.zh: 小闹钟照片正下方的商品说明写着「不含电池」。

examples.en: I almost missed “Batteries not included” because the words appeared below the product details.
examples.zh: 「不含电池」几个字出现在商品详情下面，我差点没看到。

collocations: a listing marked batteries not included
read batteries not included on the box

words.enDefinition: Directions for cleaning and maintaining an item without damaging it.

examples.en: I looked for the care instructions before selecting a pale cover for the dorm chair.
examples.zh: 为宿舍椅子挑浅色椅套前，我找了找「养护说明」。

examples.en: The care instructions were printed below the material information on the product page for the bag.
examples.zh: 包袋商品页上，材料信息下方印有「养护说明」。

words.enDefinition: A note warning that the item's real color may differ from the image.

examples.en: The listing said “Actual color may vary” immediately below the photo of the green pouch.
examples.zh: 绿色小包照片的正下方注明了「实物颜色可能有差异」。

examples.en: I saw “Actual color may vary” and decided to look at a few buyer photos.
examples.zh: 我看到「实物颜色可能有差异」，于是决定看看买家拍的照片。

collocations: a note saying actual color may vary
a caption reading actual color may vary
a listing stating actual color may vary

words.enDefinition: A score a customer gives an item based on their experience.

examples.en: The customer rating caught my eye, but I still wanted to see what people wrote.
examples.zh: 「顾客评分」吸引了我的注意，但我还是想看看大家具体写了什么。

examples.en: One customer rating came from someone who used the lamp in a room like mine.
examples.zh: 有一条「顾客评分」来自在和我房间类似的地方使用这盏灯的人。

words.enDefinition: A score reflecting customers' experiences with a seller rather than an individual product.

examples.en: I checked the seller rating because two shops offered the same lamp on the marketplace.
examples.zh: 交易平台上两家店都卖这款台灯，所以我查看了「卖家评分」。

examples.en: The seller rating appeared beside the shop name, above the stars for the individual notebook.
examples.zh: 「卖家评分」在店名旁边，位置高于这款笔记本的星级评分。

collocations: a seller rating based on recent orders

words.enDefinition: A score shown as a number of stars on a rating scale.

examples.en: I noticed the star rating in the results before opening the page for the organizer.
examples.zh: 打开收纳架页面之前，我就留意到了搜索结果里的「星级评分」。

examples.en: The form asked me to give a star rating before writing about the pencil case.
examples.zh: 表单要求我先给「星级评分」，再写对这个笔袋的评价。

words.enDefinition: A display showing how many ratings fall into each score or star level.

examples.en: The rating breakdown showed a mix of very positive and very negative scores for the lamp.
examples.zh: 「各档评分分布」显示，这盏灯的评分里有很高的，也有很低的。

examples.en: I opened the rating breakdown to see how many buyers had given just one star.
examples.zh: 我打开「各档评分分布」，想看看有多少买家只给了一星。

collocations: a chart with the rating breakdown

words.enDefinition: The overall score calculated from the ratings submitted for an item.

examples.en: The page displayed the average rating beside the number of people who had rated the notebook.
examples.zh: 页面把「平均评分」显示在给这款笔记本打分的人数旁边。

examples.en: I checked the average rating, then read comments from students who used the same planner.
examples.zh: 我先查看了「平均评分」，然后读了使用同款手账的学生写的评论。

collocations: an average rating of four stars

words.enDefinition: Rated more highly than most comparable products on a site or list.

examples.en: I looked at a few top-rated lamps before finding one small enough for my shelf.
examples.zh: 我看了几款「评分靠前的」台灯，才找到一款小到能放在架子上的。

examples.en: The site grouped its top-rated pencil cases under a heading near the search results.
examples.zh: 网站把「评分靠前的」笔袋归到搜索结果附近的一个栏目里。

words.enDefinition: The total number of reviews shown for an item.

examples.en: The review count was low because the blue version had appeared on the site recently.
examples.zh: 蓝色版本最近刚上架，所以「评价数量」不多。

examples.en: I chose to look at the review count before reading the longer written comments.
examples.zh: 我先查看了「评价数量」，再去读较长的文字评论。

words.enDefinition: To submit a written opinion based on experience with an item.

examples.en: I decided to write a review after using the laptop stand for an entire semester.
examples.zh: 那款电脑支架用了一整个学期后，我决定「撰写评价」。

examples.en: The shop invited me to write a review a week after the organizer arrived.
examples.zh: 收纳架送到一周后，商家邀请我「撰写评价」。

collocations: write a review of an item
be invited to write a review

words.enDefinition: The short title at the top of a customer review.

examples.en: The review headline mentioned the short cord, and the comment explained why it mattered.
examples.zh: 「评价标题」提到了线缆短，正文解释了这为什么重要。

examples.en: The form let me add a review headline after describing how I used the lamp.
examples.zh: 我写完台灯的使用情况后，表单允许我补写「评价标题」。

words.enDefinition: A label indicating the platform has confirmed a reviewer bought the item through it.

examples.en: The verified purchase label appeared next to a comment about the bag's shoulder strap.
examples.zh: 一条关于背包肩带的评论旁有「已核实购买」标识。

examples.en: I noticed the verified purchase badge when reading a review of the narrow desk lamp.
examples.zh: 看窄款台灯的评价时，我留意到了「已核实购买」标识。

collocations: mark a review as a verified purchase

words.enDefinition: Pictures uploaded by customers showing a product they received or used.

examples.en: I looked at customer photos to see how the blue cover appeared in daylight.
examples.zh: 我看了「买家实拍图」，想知道蓝色封套在日光下是什么颜色。

examples.en: Several customer photos showed the stand folded up beside a ruler on a desk.
examples.zh: 几张「买家实拍图」里，折好的支架摆在书桌上的一把尺旁。

collocations: add customer photos to a review

words.enDefinition: A product review that includes one or more photographs from the reviewer.

examples.en: A review with photos showed how the small lamp clipped onto a narrow shelf.
examples.zh: 一条「带图评价」展示了小灯是怎么夹在窄架上的。

examples.en: I left a review with photos showing the notebook after a semester of daily use.
examples.zh: 我发了一条「带图评价」，照片里是每天使用、用了一学期后的笔记本。

words.enDefinition: A review that gives information another shopper finds useful.

examples.en: A helpful review explained which tablets fit inside the sleeve with a keyboard attached.
examples.zh: 一条「有参考价值的评价」说明了哪些平板装着键盘也能放进内胆包。

examples.en: I found a helpful review that described how bright the lamp looked in a small room.
examples.zh: 我找到了一条「有参考价值的评价」，描述了这盏灯在小房间里有多亮。

words.enDefinition: The reviews submitted nearest to the present time.

examples.en: I checked the most recent reviews to see whether anyone mentioned the redesigned pencil case.
examples.zh: 我查看了「最近发布的评价」，想看看有没有人提到改版后的笔袋。

examples.en: The most recent reviews were about the new version with a longer power cord.
examples.zh: 「最近发布的评价」说的都是带较长电源线的新款。

collocations: show the most recent reviews first

words.enDefinition: a customer review that focuses on faults or weaknesses

examples.en: I read a critical review that noted the lid did not fit this version.
examples.zh: 我读到一条「指出不足的评价」，说这款的盖子不合适。

examples.en: A critical review pointed out that the printed guide did not explain the controls.
examples.zh: 一条「指出不足的评价」提到，纸质指南没有说明各个按键的用法。

words.enDefinition: An expression used in reviews to say someone would suggest an item to others.

examples.en: The review said “Would recommend” and explained why the organizer worked well in a dorm.
examples.zh: 评价写了「愿意推荐」，还说了为什么这款收纳架在宿舍里好用。

examples.en: I wrote that I would recommend the folder to anyone who carries notes between classes.
examples.zh: 我在评价中写道，自己「愿意推荐」这款文件夹给课间携带笔记的人。

collocations: would recommend it for daily use
say you would recommend an item

words.enDefinition: A review written in exchange for an incentive such as a free sample or reward.

examples.en: The page labeled one comment as an incentivized review because the buyer received a sample.
examples.zh: 因为买家拿到了试用样品，页面把一条评论标为「有奖励的评价」。

examples.en: I noticed the incentivized review included a disclosure next to the customer's profile photo.
examples.zh: 我注意到这条「有奖励的评价」在顾客头像旁注明了有奖励。

words.enDefinition: A product placement that appears because the seller paid to promote it.

examples.en: The first sponsored listing appeared above the desk lamps that matched my search terms.
examples.zh: 第一条「付费推广商品条目」显示在符合我搜索词的台灯上面。

examples.en: I spotted the sponsored listing by the label next to the model's name on the page.
examples.zh: 我看到页面上型号名称旁的标识，认出了「付费推广商品条目」。

collocations: a sponsored listing near the top
mark an item as a sponsored listing

words.enDefinition: Matching the appearance shown in an image or online listing.

examples.en: The pencil case looked exactly as pictured, even in the darker corner of my desk.
examples.zh: 即使放在光线较暗的桌角，这个笔袋看起来也「与图片一致」。

examples.en: One buyer said the box was as pictured and uploaded a photo on the review page.
examples.zh: 一位买家说收纳盒「与图片一致」，还在评价页上传了一张照片。

words.enDefinition: Matching the information given in the written description.

examples.en: The clip light worked as described and fit on the shelf beside my bed.
examples.zh: 夹灯的表现「与说明一致」，也能夹在我床边的架子上。

examples.en: The refill pack arrived as described, with the same page layout shown in the pictures.
examples.zh: 内页补充装到手后「与说明一致」，页面版式也跟图上一样。

words.enDefinition: Having the same color as the color shown or advertised.

examples.en: The retailer’s photo was true to color, according to a reviewer who picked yellow.
examples.zh: 一位选了黄色款的评价者说，商家照片「与实物颜色相符」。

examples.en: My roommate said her photos were true to color because she took them in daylight.
examples.zh: 室友说她是在日光下拍的，所以照片「与实物颜色相符」。

collocations: a photo that is true to color

words.enDefinition: How well an item is made, assembled, and finished.

examples.en: Several reviewers liked the build quality of the lamp but mentioned the short power cord.
examples.zh: 几名评价者满意这盏灯的「做工质量」，但提到了电源线较短。

examples.en: I could not judge the build quality of the laptop stand from the photos alone.
examples.zh: 单凭照片，我判断不出电脑支架的「做工质量」。

words.enDefinition: Remains in good condition through continued normal use.

examples.en: The cover holds up well in my backpack even when I carry it every day.
examples.zh: 即使每天都把封套装在背包里，它也很「经用」。

examples.en: A reviewer wrote that the handle holds up well after a year of commuting.
examples.zh: 一位评价者写道，通勤用了一年后，提手依然很「经用」。

collocations: holds up well to daily use

words.enDefinition: A section where people ask and answer questions about an item.

examples.en: I found the cord length in the questions and answers section below the lamp reviews.
examples.zh: 我在台灯评价下方的「商品问答」里找到了线缆长度。

examples.en: The questions and answers section included several replies from people who owned the same organizer.
examples.zh: 「商品问答」里有几条拥有同款收纳架的人给出的回复。

words.enDefinition: A public reply from the seller to a shopper's review or product question.

examples.en: The seller response explained which refills fitted the older version of the notebook cover.
examples.zh: 「卖家回复」说明了旧版笔记本封套适用哪些替换内页。

examples.en: A seller response beneath one review gave the dimensions of the larger storage tray.
examples.zh: 一条评价下方的「卖家回复」给出了大号收纳托盘的尺寸。

collocations: a seller response to a review

words.enDefinition: A table showing product features or specifications together to make differences easy to see.

examples.en: The comparison chart showed which model had the longest cable and the widest base.
examples.zh: 「对比表」显示了哪个型号的线缆最长、底座最宽。

examples.en: I used the comparison chart to decide which pencil case would hold my geometry tools.
examples.zh: 我用了「对比表」来判断哪个笔袋放得下我的几何工具。

words.enDefinition: To put a selected item into the list of things you may buy.

examples.en: I clicked “Add to cart” after choosing the blue cover for my new notebook.
examples.zh: 为新笔记本选了蓝色封套后，我点了「加入购物车」。

examples.en: The “Add to cart” button became available when I selected a size from the menu.
examples.zh: 我在菜单里选好尺寸后，「加入购物车」按钮就可以点了。

collocations: select a size before using add to cart

words.enDefinition: To take a selected item out of an online purchase list.

examples.en: I clicked “Remove from cart” after noticing I had selected the same folder twice.
examples.zh: 发现重复选了同款文件夹后，我点了「移出购物车」。

examples.en: The “Remove from cart” option appeared beneath each of the items I had selected.
examples.zh: 我选的每件商品下方都显示了「移出购物车」选项。

words.enDefinition: To open the list of items currently selected for purchase.

examples.en: I clicked “View cart” to make sure the lamp was still on the list.
examples.zh: 我点了「查看购物车」，确认台灯还在列表里。

examples.en: The store displayed a “View cart” link after I added a packet of refills.
examples.zh: 我加了一包替芯后，商店显示了「查看购物车」链接。

words.enDefinition: To change how many units of a selected item the order contains.

examples.en: I clicked “Update quantity” after my roommate said she also needed a set of folders.
examples.zh: 室友说她也需要一套文件夹后，我点了「更新数量」。

examples.en: The “Update quantity” button changed the number of notebooks without removing my other items.
examples.zh: 「更新数量」按钮改了笔记本的件数，其他商品还留着。

words.enDefinition: To keep an item on a separate list without buying it now.

examples.en: I used “Save for later” because I still needed to measure the shelf in my room.
examples.zh: 我用了「保存供日后购买」，因为还得量一下房间里的架子。

examples.en: The “Save for later” list held the other color while I ordered the green cover.
examples.zh: 我下单买绿色封套时，另一种颜色还留在「保存供日后购买」的列表里。

collocations: move something to the save for later list

words.enDefinition: A notice saying that selected items are not being held for a particular shopper.

examples.en: The cart displayed “Items are not reserved” below the notebook I had selected earlier.
examples.zh: 购物车在我先前选的笔记本下方显示「商品未预留」。

examples.en: The site reminded shoppers that items are not reserved while they remain in the cart.
examples.zh: 网站提醒顾客，商品还在购物车里时，「商品未预留」。

collocations: a note saying items are not reserved
items are not reserved until checkout
a message reading items are not reserved

words.enDefinition: The combined price of selected items before any additional charges are applied.

examples.en: The cart subtotal changed after I removed the spare cable from my list of items.
examples.zh: 我把备用线缆从清单上移除后，「购物车商品小计」变了。

examples.en: I checked the cart subtotal before deciding who would order the materials for our project.
examples.zh: 我先核对了「购物车商品小计」，才决定小组项目的材料由谁下单。

collocations: a change in the cart subtotal

words.enDefinition: A short overview of the items and details in an order.

examples.en: The order summary listed both colors, although I was expecting to buy only the blue one.
examples.zh: 「订单摘要」列了两种颜色，虽然我原本只想买蓝色的。

examples.en: I checked the order summary carefully to make sure the two folders were the same size.
examples.zh: 我仔细检查「订单摘要」，确认两个文件夹的尺寸一样。

collocations: an item in the order summary

words.enDefinition: To continue from the selected items to the next steps in placing an order.

examples.en: I clicked “Proceed to checkout” after making sure the two covers were both the right size.
examples.zh: 确认两个封套的尺寸都对后，我点了「前往结算」。

examples.en: The site asked me to proceed to checkout to review my order and delivery choices.
examples.zh: 网站提示我「前往结算」以核对订单和配送选项。

words.enDefinition: An option to place an order without creating or using a store account.

examples.en: I used guest checkout because I was ordering a replacement cover from the store just once.
examples.zh: 我只会在这家店买一次备用封套，所以用了「游客结算」。

examples.en: Our group chose guest checkout when ordering a set of folders for the new project.
examples.zh: 给新项目买一套文件夹时，我们小组选了「游客结算」。

words.enDefinition: An option to go straight to buying the selected item.

examples.en: I clicked “Buy now” because the notebook was the only thing I wanted to order.
examples.zh: 我只想订那本笔记本，所以点了「立即购买」。

examples.en: For each color, the page showed the “Buy now” option beside the cart button.
examples.zh: 页面上，每种颜色旁的购物车按钮边上都有一个「立即购买」选项。

words.enDefinition: To look through an order and check its details before submitting it.

examples.en: The page said “Review your order” above the list of colors and quantities we had chosen.
examples.zh: 页面在我们选好的颜色和数量列表上方写着「核对订单」。

examples.en: I noticed the “Review your order” step was still available before I submitted the purchase.
examples.zh: 提交购买前，我留意到还可以回到「核对订单」这一步。

collocations: be prompted to review your order

words.enDefinition: A status saying an order has been successfully submitted to the seller.

examples.en: The status changed to “Order placed” after I submitted our request for the binder clips.
examples.zh: 我提交长尾夹订单后，状态改成了「已下单」。

examples.en: I took a screenshot of the page marked “Order placed” for our group's records.
examples.zh: 我给标着「已下单」的页面截了图，留作小组记录。

words.enDefinition: A list of orders previously placed through an account.

examples.en: I found the pen I wanted to buy again by looking through my order history.
examples.zh: 我翻了「历史订单」，找到了想再买一支的笔。

examples.en: My order history showed that I had chosen the smaller size on my previous purchase.
examples.zh: 「历史订单」显示我上次买的是较小的尺寸。

collocations: find an item in your order history

words.enDefinition: The unique reference used to identify a particular order.

examples.en: I wrote down the order number before closing the tab for the stationery store.
examples.zh: 我记下了「订单编号」，才关掉文具店网站的标签页。

examples.en: The order number appeared beside my name at the top of the confirmation email.
examples.zh: 确认邮件的顶部，我的姓名旁边显示了「订单编号」。

words.enDefinition: An unintended second order for the same items.

examples.en: I checked my inbox for a duplicate order after my browser briefly stopped responding.
examples.zh: 浏览器短暂卡住后，我查看了收件箱，看看是否生成了「重复订单」。

examples.en: My roommate noticed a duplicate order for the desk lamp in the account history.
examples.zh: 室友在账户的历史记录里发现了台灯的「重复订单」。

words.enDefinition: The largest number of units a shopper is allowed to buy under the stated terms.

examples.en: The listing showed a purchase limit of two for the popular campus notebooks today.
examples.zh: 今天，商品页显示这款热门校园笔记本的「购买数量上限」是两本。

examples.en: I read the purchase limit before offering to order folders for the whole group.
examples.zh: 我看了「购买数量上限」，才提出帮整个小组买文件夹。

words.enDefinition: No longer available to buy because all the available units have been sold.

examples.en: The small white lamp was sold out, but the black version was still available.
examples.zh: 小号白色台灯「已售罄」，黑色款仍然可以买到。

examples.en: The page said the planner was sold out after I selected the illustrated cover.
examples.zh: 我选了带插图的封面后，页面显示手账「已售罄」。

words.enDefinition: To order a product before it becomes generally available.

examples.en: I decided to preorder the planner because it was scheduled for release before term started.
examples.zh: 这款手账定于开学前上市，我决定现在就「预订」。

examples.en: The store let me preorder the book when only the cover design had been announced.
examples.zh: 商店只公布了封面设计，就允许我「预订」这本书。

words.enDefinition: Produced after a customer orders it instead of being stocked in advance.

examples.en: The print was made to order, so the seller gave a separate estimate for preparation.
examples.zh: 那幅印刷画是「按订单制作」的，所以卖家单独给了预计备货时间。

examples.en: I chose a folder made to order with my initials printed below the class name.
examples.zh: 我选了一个「按订单制作」的文件夹，能在班级名称下方印姓名缩写。

words.enDefinition: A choice that lets a shopper add personal details to an item.

examples.en: The personalization option let me add my initials to the cover of the project notebook.
examples.zh: 「个性化定制选项」让我可以在项目笔记本封面上加上姓名缩写。

examples.en: I looked at the personalization option but decided to leave the front of the folder blank.
examples.zh: 我看了「个性化定制选项」，最后还是决定把文件夹正面留白。

words.enDefinition: A short message the buyer asks a seller to include with a gift.

examples.en: I added a gift message to the notebook I ordered for my roommate's graduation.
examples.zh: 我给室友订了本笔记本作为毕业礼物，还附上了「礼品附言」。

examples.en: The page gave me room to write a gift message below the recipient's name.
examples.zh: 页面在收礼人姓名下方留了空间填写「礼品附言」。

words.enDefinition: To tell an online shop that the order is intended as a gift for someone.

examples.en: The shop let me order as a gift when I bought the notebook for my sister.
examples.zh: 我给姐姐买笔记本时，店铺允许我「按礼品下单」。

examples.en: I chose “Order as a gift” before adding a note for my roommate's graduation.
examples.zh: 我先选择「按礼品下单」，再附上一条祝贺室友毕业的留言。

collocations: choose to order as a gift
an option to order as a gift
a box marked order as a gift

words.enDefinition: Wrapping provided to make a purchased item ready to give as a gift.

examples.en: The shop offered gift wrapping for the pen set I was sending to my sister.
examples.zh: 店铺为我准备送给姐姐的套笔提供「礼品包装」。

examples.en: I selected gift wrapping because the planner was going straight to my friend's residence hall.
examples.zh: 我选了「礼品包装」，因为手账会直接寄到朋友的宿舍楼。

words.enDefinition: Additional information a shopper adds to an order for the seller to read.

examples.en: I wrote in the order notes that the folders were for a classroom project.
examples.zh: 我在「订单备注」里写明，这些文件夹是课堂项目用的。

examples.en: The box for order notes was below the list of colors I had selected.
examples.zh: 「订单备注」输入框在我选好的颜色列表下方。

words.enDefinition: The available methods for sending a purchased item to the buyer.

examples.en: The shipping options appeared after I entered the postal code for my student residence.
examples.zh: 我输入学生宿舍的邮编后，页面显示了「配送选项」。

examples.en: I checked the shipping options early because I needed the folder before our workshop.
examples.zh: 因为研讨活动前就需要文件夹，我提前查看了「配送选项」。

words.enDefinition: Limits on which items can be sent or where they can be delivered.

examples.en: The product page listed shipping restrictions for a few colors made at a different warehouse.
examples.zh: 商品页列出了由另一个仓库供货的几种颜色的「配送限制」。

examples.en: I read the shipping restrictions before sending the art supplies to my friend's residence hall.
examples.zh: 给朋友的宿舍楼寄美术用品前，我查看了「配送限制」。

words.enDefinition: A listing label introducing the location from which an item will be sent.

examples.en: The line marked “Ships from” gave a different location than the shop’s mailing address.
examples.zh: 「发货地」一栏所列的地点与店铺通信地址不同。

examples.en: I looked at “Ships from” to see whether the notebook would come from a local warehouse.
examples.zh: 我查看了「发货地」，想知道笔记本是否从本地仓库发货。

collocations: check where an item ships from

words.enDefinition: A label introducing the estimated wait before an item is sent.

examples.en: The listing said “Ships in two days” rather than giving an exact arrival date.
examples.zh: 商品页写的是「预计两天后发货」，没有给出具体送达日期。

examples.en: I saw “Ships in one week” after choosing the print with my name on it.
examples.zh: 选了印自己姓名的印刷画后，我看到「预计一周后发货」。

collocations: a listing marked ships in two days
read ships in beside the estimate
a message saying ships in two weeks

words.enDefinition: The date on which a seller expects to send an item out.

examples.en: The estimated dispatch date was displayed next to the name of the personalized notebook.
examples.zh: 「预计发货日期」显示在那本定制笔记本的名称旁边。

examples.en: I wrote down the estimated dispatch date so I knew when to expect another update.
examples.zh: 我记下了「预计发货日期」，以便知道什么时候可以留意下一条消息。

collocations: an estimated dispatch date for the order

words.enDefinition: The expected period needed to prepare an order before it is sent or collected.

examples.en: The estimated processing time was longer for mugs with names printed on the side.
examples.zh: 杯身印有名字的马克杯，订单的「预计处理时间」更长。

examples.en: I checked the estimated processing time before ordering a notebook for my roommate's birthday.
examples.zh: 为室友生日订笔记本之前，我查看了订单的「预计处理时间」。

collocations: an estimated processing time of three days

words.enDefinition: Individual packages used to send different parts of the same order.

examples.en: The page showed that the lamp and the spare bulbs would arrive in separate packages.
examples.zh: 页面显示，台灯和备用灯泡会通过「分开的包裹」送达。

examples.en: My notebook and the matching refill set came in separate packages on different days.
examples.zh: 我的笔记本和配套替芯放在「不同包裹」里，在不同的日子送达。

words.enDefinition: A status showing that the seller is preparing an order before dispatch or collection.

examples.en: The page showed “Processing order” while the shop was preparing our group purchase of folders.
examples.zh: 店铺为我们的小组采购准备文件夹时，页面显示「正在处理订单」。

examples.en: I saw “Processing order” next to the notebook before the dispatch details appeared online.
examples.zh: 发货信息显示前，我在笔记本旁看到了「正在处理订单」。

collocations: see processing order on the page
